questions.stem: The following are true about enfuvirtide except :

options.label: B
options.text: Effective on HIV 1 and HIV 2 strains

options.label: D
options.text: No cross-resistance with other anti-retroviral drugs

questions.answerText: Effective on HIV 1 and HIV 2 strains
questions.solutionHtml:
Effective on HIV 1 and HIV 2 strains
  • Active on HIV 1& not active against HIV-2. Used as add on a drug for failed regimens


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 867

questions.stem: Which of the following is false regarding acyclovir ?

options.label: A
options.text: It inhibits DNA synthesis and viral replication

options.label: C
options.text: It has low toxicity for host cells

questions.solutionHtml:
It is effective against influenza
  • Acyclovir monophosphate is converted to diphosphate by cellular guanylate kinase and to triphosphate by a number of other cellular enzymes.
